/* ========= GRAVITY ========= */
let galPts=[],galRunning=false,galFrame=0,galCtx,galW,galH;
sl('gn','gn-v');sl('gg','gg-v',v=>v.toFixed(2));sl('gv','gv-v',v=>v.toFixed(1));sl('gtrail','gt-v',v=>['','None','Short','Medium','Long','Full'][v]);
function initGalaxy(){
  const r=clr('galC',430);galW=r.W;galH=430;galCtx=r.ctx;
  galPts=[];galFrame=0;galRunning=true;
  const n=val('gn'),v0=val('gv'),mode=document.getElementById('gmode').value;
  const cx=galW/2,cy=galH/2;
  const hues=[210,260,30,150,320,60,180,0,45,280];
  if(mode==='random'){for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,r2=Math.random()*Math.min(galW,galH)*0.37;galPts.push({x:cx+Math.cos(a)*r2,y:cy+Math.sin(a)*r2,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*v0,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*v0,m:0.5+Math.random()*2,c:`hsl(${hues[i%hues.length]},75%,65%)`});}}
  else if(mode==='disk'){for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,r2=15+Math.pow(Math.random(),0.5)*Math.min(galW,galH)*0.33;const sp=v0*Math.sqrt(0.8/(r2*0.008+0.1));galPts.push({x:cx+Math.cos(a)*r2,y:cy+Math.sin(a)*r2,vx:-Math.sin(a)*sp+(Math.random()-.5)*0.3,vy:Math.cos(a)*sp+(Math.random()-.5)*0.3,m:0.5+Math.random(),c:`hsl(${190+Math.random()*70},80%,60%)`});}}
  else if(mode==='collision'){const off=Math.min(galW,galH)*0.22;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const s=i<n/2;const cx2=s?cx-off:cx+off;const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,r2=Math.random()*off*0.5;galPts.push({x:cx2+Math.cos(a)*r2,y:cy+Math.sin(a)*r2*0.65,vx:(s?v0*0.5:-v0*0.5)+(Math.random()-.5)*0.4,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*0.35,m:0.5+Math.random(),c:`hsl(${s?210:25},80%,65%)`});}}
  else if(mode==='ring'){for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const a=(i/n)*Math.PI*2,r2=Math.min(galW,galH)*0.29;galPts.push({x:cx+Math.cos(a)*r2+(Math.random()-.5)*16,y:cy+Math.sin(a)*r2+(Math.random()-.5)*16,vx:-Math.sin(a)*v0*1.3,vy:Math.cos(a)*v0*1.3,m:0.5+Math.random(),c:`hsl(${270+i/n*90},70%,65%)`});}}
  else{galPts.push({x:cx-90,y:cy,vx:0,vy:v0*0.5,m:10,c:'#ff9955'},{x:cx+90,y:cy,vx:0,vy:-v0*0.5,m:10,c:'#55aaff'});for(let i=2;i<n;i++){const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,r2=20+Math.random()*Math.min(galW,galH)*0.36;galPts.push({x:cx+Math.cos(a)*r2,y:cy+Math.sin(a)*r2,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*v0*0.8,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*v0*0.8,m:0.3+Math.random(),c:`hsl(${Math.random()*360},70%,65%)`});}}
  galCtx.fillStyle='#030508';galCtx.fillRect(0,0,galW,galH);
  requestAnimationFrame(galLoop);
}
function galLoop(){
  if(!galRunning)return;
  const G=val('gg'),tr=val('gtrail');
  const alpha=[0,0.4,0.2,0.11,0.05,0][tr]||0.11;
  galCtx.fillStyle=`rgba(3,5,8,${alpha})`;galCtx.fillRect(0,0,galW,galH);
  const pts=galPts,n=pts.length;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const a=pts[i];for(let j=i+1;j<n;j++){const b=pts[j];const dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y;const d2=dx*dx+dy*dy,d=Math.sqrt(d2)+6;const f=G*a.m*b.m/(d2+40);const fx=f*dx/d,fy=f*dy/d;a.vx+=fx/a.m;a.vy+=fy/a.m;b.vx-=fx/b.m;b.vy-=fy/b.m;}}
  let ke=0,ms=0;
  pts.forEach(p=>{const sp=Math.sqrt(p.vx**2+p.vy**2);if(sp>ms)ms=sp;const cap=10;if(sp>cap){p.vx=p.vx/sp*cap;p.vy=p.vy/sp*cap;}p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;if(p.x<2){p.x=2;p.vx*=-0.6;}if(p.x>galW-2){p.x=galW-2;p.vx*=-0.6;}if(p.y<2){p.y=2;p.vy*=-0.6;}if(p.y>galH-2){p.y=galH-2;p.vy*=-0.6;}ke+=0.5*p.m*sp**2;if(sp>1.5){galCtx.beginPath();galCtx.moveTo(p.x,p.y);galCtx.lineTo(p.x-p.vx*2.5,p.y-p.vy*2.5);const col=p.c.includes('hsl')?p.c.replace('hsl(','hsla(').replace(')',',0.18)'):p.c+'2e';galCtx.strokeStyle=col;galCtx.lineWidth=0.8;galCtx.stroke();}const rr=Math.min(5,1.2+p.m*0.7);galCtx.beginPath();galCtx.arc(p.x,p.y,rr,0,Math.PI*2);galCtx.fillStyle=p.c;galCtx.fill();});
  galFrame++;set('gal-fr',galFrame);set('gal-ke',ke.toFixed(0));set('gal-n',n);set('gal-ms',ms.toFixed(2));
  if(galFrame%50===0){let cl=0;const vis=new Set();pts.forEach((a,i)=>{if(vis.has(i))return;let inCl=false;pts.forEach((b,j)=>{if(i!==j&&Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y)<55){inCl=true;vis.add(j);}});if(inCl)cl++;});set('gal-cl',cl);}
  requestAnimationFrame(galLoop);
}
btn('gal-launch',initGalaxy);
btn('gal-pause',function(){galRunning=!galRunning;this.textContent=galRunning?'Pause':'Resume';if(galRunning)requestAnimationFrame(galLoop);});
btn('gal-clear',()=>{if(galCtx){galCtx.fillStyle='#030508';galCtx.fillRect(0,0,galW,galH);}});

/* ========= CLT ========= */
let cltMeans=[];sl('clt-n','clt-n-v');
function popSample(dist){if(dist==='uniform')return Math.random()*10;if(dist==='exp')return -Math.log(Math.random())*3;if(dist==='bimodal')return Math.random()<0.5?randn()*0.9+2:randn()*0.9+8;if(dist==='bernoulli')return Math.random()<0.2?1:0;if(dist==='pareto')return Math.min(50,Math.pow(Math.random()+0.001,-1/1.5));if(dist==='cauchy')return Math.tan(Math.PI*(Math.random()-0.5));return randn()*3+5;}
function popTheory(dist){return{uniform:{mu:5,sig:Math.sqrt(100/12)},exp:{mu:3,sig:3},bimodal:{mu:5,sig:3.1},bernoulli:{mu:0.2,sig:0.4},pareto:{mu:null,sig:null},cauchy:{mu:null,sig:null}}[dist]||{mu:null,sig:null};}
function drawPop(){const r=clr('popC',180);const{ctx,W,H}=r;const dist=document.getElementById('clt-dist').value;const pts=Array.from({length:3000},()=>popSample(dist)).filter(v=>isFinite(v)&&Math.abs(v)<60);const mn=Math.min(...pts),mx=Math.max(...pts);const bins=30,bw=(mx-mn)/bins||0.001;const counts=new Array(bins).fill(0);pts.forEach(v=>{const i=Math.min(bins-1,Math.floor((v-mn)/bw));counts[i]++;});const maxC=Math.max(...counts)||1;const pad=8,iW=W-2*pad,iH=H-24;counts.forEach((c,i)=>{const bh=c/maxC*iH;ctx.fillStyle='rgba(37,99,235,0.5)';ctx.fillRect(pad+i*iW/bins,H-16-bh,iW/bins-1,bh);});ctx.fillStyle='rgba(100,100,100,0.6)';ctx.font='11px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText(mn.toFixed(1),pad,H-2);ctx.fillText(mx.toFixed(1),W-pad,H-2);}
function drawCLT(){const r=clr('cltC',180);const{ctx,W,H}=r;if(!cltMeans.length){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(120,120,120,0.4)';ctx.font='13px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('Click "+500 samples" to start',W/2,90);return;}const valid=cltMeans.filter(v=>isFinite(v)&&Math.abs(v)<200);if(!valid.length)return;const mn=Math.min(...valid),mx=Math.max(...valid);const bins=30,bw=(mx-mn)/bins||0.001;const counts=new Array(bins).fill(0);valid.forEach(v=>{const i=Math.min(bins-1,Math.floor((v-mn)/bw));counts[i]++;});const maxC=Math.max(...counts)||1;const pad=8,iW=W-2*pad,iH=H-24;counts.forEach((c,i)=>{const bh=c/maxC*iH;ctx.fillStyle='rgba(5,150,105,0.55)';ctx.fillRect(pad+i*iW/bins,H-16-bh,iW/bins-1,bh);});if(valid.length>100){const m=mean(valid),s=sdv(valid);ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(220,38,38,0.9)';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();for(let px=0;px<iW;px++){const xv=mn+px/iW*(mx-mn);const norm=Math.exp(-0.5*((xv-m)/s)**2)/(s*Math.sqrt(2*Math.PI));const bh=norm*bw*valid.length/maxC*iH;const py=H-16-bh;px===0?ctx.moveTo(pad+px,py):ctx.lineTo(pad+px,py);}ctx.stroke();}}
function cltStep(k){const n=val('clt-n'),dist=document.getElementById('clt-dist').value;for(let i=0;i<k;i++){const pts=Array.from({length:n},()=>popSample(dist)).filter(v=>isFinite(v)&&Math.abs(v)<500);if(pts.length>0)cltMeans.push(mean(pts));}const valid=cltMeans.filter(v=>isFinite(v));const m=mean(valid),s=sdv(valid);const th=popTheory(dist);set('clt-s',valid.length);set('clt-m',isFinite(m)?m.toFixed(3):'undefined');set('clt-se',isFinite(s)?s.toFixed(3):'undefined');set('clt-tse',th.sig?((th.sig/Math.sqrt(n)).toFixed(3)):'N/A');const normEl=document.getElementById('clt-norm');if(dist==='cauchy'){normEl.textContent='FAILS';normEl.className='mv r';}else if(n>=30&&valid.length>=500){normEl.textContent='Normal';normEl.className='mv g';}else if(n>=5){normEl.textContent='Emerging';normEl.className='mv a';}else{normEl.textContent='Not yet';normEl.className='mv';}drawCLT();}
function resetCLT(){cltMeans=[];set('clt-s',0);['clt-m','clt-se','clt-tse','clt-norm'].forEach(id=>set(id,'—'));drawPop();drawCLT();}
btn('clt-500',()=>cltStep(500));btn('clt-2000',()=>cltStep(2000));btn('clt-reset',resetCLT);
document.getElementById('clt-dist').addEventListener('change',resetCLT);
document.getElementById('clt-n').addEventListener('input',resetCLT);

/* ========= COIN TOSSES ========= */
let coinHistory=[],coinHeads=0,coinTotal=0,coinAuto=null;
sl('coin-p','coin-p-v',v=>v.toFixed(2));
function resetCoin(){coinHistory=[];coinHeads=0;coinTotal=0;set('coin-n',0);set('coin-h',0);set('coin-ph','—');set('coin-true',val('coin-p').toFixed(2));set('coin-diff','—');drawCoin();}
function coinStep(){const p=val('coin-p');const batch=+document.getElementById('coin-batch').value;for(let i=0;i<batch;i++){coinTotal++;if(Math.random()<p)coinHeads++;coinHistory.push(coinHeads/coinTotal);}set('coin-n',coinTotal.toLocaleString());set('coin-h',coinHeads.toLocaleString());set('coin-ph',(coinHeads/coinTotal).toFixed(4));set('coin-true',p.toFixed(2));set('coin-diff',((coinHeads/coinTotal)-p).toFixed(4));drawCoin();}
function drawCoin(){const r=clr('coinC',360);const{ctx,W,H}=r;ctx.fillStyle='rgba(37,99,235,0.06)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);const pad=34;const iW=W-2*pad,iH=H-2*pad;ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.12)';ctx.strokeRect(pad,pad,iW,iH);const p=val('coin-p');const yTrue=pad+(1-p)*iH;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pad,yTrue);ctx.lineTo(W-pad,yTrue);ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(220,38,38,0.9)';ctx.lineWidth=1.7;ctx.stroke();if(coinHistory.length){ctx.beginPath();coinHistory.forEach((v,i)=>{const x=pad+(i/(Math.max(coinHistory.length-1,1)))*iW;const y=pad+(1-v)*iH;i===0?ctx.moveTo(x,y):ctx.lineTo(x,y);});ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(5,150,105,0.95)';ctx.lineWidth=2.2;ctx.stroke();}ctx.fillStyle='rgba(100,100,100,0.75)';ctx.font='11px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='right';ctx.fillText('1.0',pad-6,pad+4);ctx.fillText('0.5',pad-6,pad+iH/2+4);ctx.fillText('0.0',pad-6,pad+iH+4);ctx.textAlign='left';ctx.fillText('true p',pad+8,yTrue-8);ctx.fillText('cumulative proportion of heads',pad,H-10);}
btn('coin-step',coinStep);
btn('coin-reset',()=>{if(coinAuto){clearInterval(coinAuto);coinAuto=null;}resetCoin();});
btn('coin-auto',()=>{if(coinAuto)clearInterval(coinAuto);coinAuto=setInterval(coinStep,180);});
btn('coin-stop',()=>{if(coinAuto){clearInterval(coinAuto);coinAuto=null;}});
document.getElementById('coin-p').addEventListener('input',()=>{set('coin-true',val('coin-p').toFixed(2));drawCoin();});

/* ========= REGRESSION ========= */
let regData=[],regShowFit=true;
sl('reg-n','reg-n-v');sl('reg-slope','reg-slope-v',v=>v.toFixed(1));sl('reg-noise','reg-noise-v',v=>v.toFixed(1));
function regressionStats(data){const xs=data.map(d=>d.x),ys=data.map(d=>d.y),mx=mean(xs),my=mean(ys);let sxx=0,sxy=0,syy=0;for(let i=0;i<data.length;i++){const dx=xs[i]-mx,dy=ys[i]-my;sxx+=dx*dx;sxy+=dx*dy;syy+=dy*dy;}const b1=sxy/(sxx||1e-9),b0=my-b1*mx,r=sxy/Math.sqrt((sxx||1e-9)*(syy||1e-9));return{b0,b1,r,r2:r*r};}
function generateRegression(){const n=val('reg-n'),slope=val('reg-slope'),noise=val('reg-noise'),shape=document.getElementById('reg-shape').value;regData=[];for(let i=0;i<n;i++){let x=-5+10*Math.random(),y=0;if(shape==='linear')y=1+slope*x+randn()*noise;else if(shape==='curve')y=0.5*slope*x+0.25*x*x+randn()*noise;else{const g=Math.random()<0.5?-1:1;x=g*(1.5+Math.random()*3)+randn()*0.5;y=g*(2+slope)+randn()*noise;}regData.push({x,y});}regShowFit=true;drawRegression();}
function drawRegression(){const r=clr('regC',380),ctx=r.ctx,W=r.W,H=r.H,pad=34,iW=W-2*pad,iH=H-2*pad;ctx.fillStyle='rgba(37,99,235,0.05)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);if(!regData.length){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(120,120,120,0.6)';ctx.font='14px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('Click "Generate data"',W/2,H/2);return;}const xs=regData.map(d=>d.x),ys=regData.map(d=>d.y);const xmin=Math.min(...xs),xmax=Math.max(...xs),ymin=Math.min(...ys),ymax=Math.max(...ys);const xpad=(xmax-xmin)*0.1+0.2,ypad=(ymax-ymin)*0.1+0.2;const x0=xmin-xpad,x1=xmax+xpad,y0=ymin-ypad,y1=ymax+ypad;const xp=x=>pad+(x-x0)/(x1-x0)*iW,yp=y=>H-pad-(y-y0)/(y1-y0)*iH;ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.12)';ctx.strokeRect(pad,pad,iW,iH);regData.forEach(d=>{ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(xp(d.x),yp(d.y),4,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle='rgba(37,99,235,0.8)';ctx.fill();});const st=regressionStats(regData);set('reg-b1',st.b1.toFixed(3));set('reg-b0',st.b0.toFixed(3));set('reg-r',st.r.toFixed(3));set('reg-r2',st.r2.toFixed(3));set('reg-type',document.getElementById('reg-shape').value);if(regShowFit){const xa=x0,xb=x1,ya=st.b0+st.b1*xa,yb=st.b0+st.b1*xb;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(xp(xa),yp(ya));ctx.lineTo(xp(xb),yp(yb));ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(220,38,38,0.95)';ctx.lineWidth=2.2;ctx.stroke();}}
btn('reg-gen',generateRegression);btn('reg-reveal',()=>{regShowFit=!regShowFit;drawRegression();});
document.getElementById('reg-n').addEventListener('input',generateRegression);
document.getElementById('reg-slope').addEventListener('input',generateRegression);
document.getElementById('reg-noise').addEventListener('input',generateRegression);
document.getElementById('reg-shape').addEventListener('change',generateRegression);

/* ========= PERMUTATION TEST — now with animation ========= */
let permA=[],permB=[],permNull=[],permObs=0,permAnimating=false;
sl('perm-n','perm-n-v');sl('perm-eff','perm-eff-v',v=>v.toFixed(1));sl('perm-noise','perm-noise-v',v=>v.toFixed(1));
function updatePermExplanation(){
  const el=document.getElementById('perm-explain-text');
  if(!el)return;
  if(!permA.length){el.innerHTML='Generate data and run some permutations to see the current interpretation.';return;}
  const n=permNull.length;
  const extreme=permNull.filter(v=>Math.abs(v)>=Math.abs(permObs)).length;
  const p=n?extreme/n:null;
  const nullSD=n>1?sdv(permNull):0;
  const effMag=Math.abs(permObs);
  // where does the observed sit, in null SDs?
  const z=nullSD>0?(permObs/nullSD).toFixed(2):'—';
  let txt=`<strong>The setup.</strong> You generated two groups of ${permA.length} observations each. Group B's mean came out <strong>${effMag.toFixed(3)}</strong> units ${permObs>=0?'higher':'lower'} than Group A's mean. That is your <em>observed difference</em>. The question: how unusual is that under the null hypothesis that the groups are really the same?`;
  if(!n){
    txt+=`<br><br><strong>Next step.</strong> Click <em>"Animate one shuffle"</em> to watch a single permutation in slow motion — you'll see labels get scrambled across both groups, then a new mean difference gets computed and dropped into the histogram on the right. Click <em>"Run permutations"</em> to batch-shuffle hundreds or thousands of times and build the null distribution quickly.`;
  }else{
    const strength=p<0.01?'very strong':(p<0.05?'moderate':(p<0.1?'weak':'essentially no'));
    const reject=p<0.05;
    txt+=`<br><br><strong>After ${n.toLocaleString()} shuffles.</strong> The null distribution is centered near <strong>${mean(permNull).toFixed(3)}</strong> (as expected — the true null mean is 0) with standard deviation <strong>${nullSD.toFixed(3)}</strong>. Your observed difference sits about <strong>${z} null-SDs</strong> from the center.`;
    txt+=`<br><br><strong>Reading the histogram.</strong> The purple bars are shuffle outcomes that sit inside the null. The <span style="color:#dc2626;font-weight:600;">red bars</span> are the extreme shuffles — those where the absolute mean difference was at least as big as the one you actually observed. Of your ${n.toLocaleString()} shuffles, <strong>${extreme.toLocaleString()}</strong> (${(p*100).toFixed(1)}%) landed that far out. That fraction is your <strong>p-value ≈ ${p.toFixed(4)}</strong>.`;
    txt+=`<br><br><strong>Interpretation.</strong> There is <strong>${strength}</strong> evidence against the null hypothesis. `;
    if(reject){
      txt+=`Only ${(p*100).toFixed(1)}% of random shuffles produced a difference this large, so chance alone is an unlikely explanation — we would <strong>reject H₀</strong> at the 0.05 level and say the groups really do differ.`;
    }else{
      txt+=`Roughly ${(p*100).toFixed(0)}% of random shuffles produced a difference at least this large, which is not unusual under the null. We would <strong>fail to reject H₀</strong> at the 0.05 level — the data is consistent with the two groups having the same underlying distribution. (Note: this is <em>not</em> proof of no effect, just insufficient evidence.)`;
    }
    if(n<500){
      txt+=`<br><br><em>Tip: only ${n} shuffles so far. The p-value estimate will stabilize as you run more — try the "5,000" setting.</em>`;
    }
  }
  el.innerHTML=txt;
}
function generatePermData(){
  const n=val('perm-n'),eff=val('perm-eff'),noise=val('perm-noise');
  permA=Array.from({length:n},()=>({v:randn()*noise,label:'A',origLabel:'A'}));
  permB=Array.from({length:n},()=>({v:eff+randn()*noise,label:'B',origLabel:'B'}));
  permObs=mean(permB.map(d=>d.v))-mean(permA.map(d=>d.v));
  permNull=[];
  set('perm-obs',permObs.toFixed(3));set('perm-count',0);set('perm-p','—');set('perm-nullm','—');set('perm-nulls','—');
  drawPermData();drawPermNull();updatePermExplanation();
}
function onePerm(){
  const all=permA.concat(permB).slice();
  for(let i=all.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[all[i],all[j]]=[all[j],all[i]];}
  const n=permA.length;
  const a=all.slice(0,n).map(d=>d.v),b=all.slice(n).map(d=>d.v);
  return mean(b)-mean(a);
}
// Animated single-permutation: visibly shuffle labels
async function animatePerm(){
  if(permAnimating||!permA.length)return;
  permAnimating=true;
  const all=permA.concat(permB);
  // assign random labels
  const newLabels=all.map((_,i)=>i<permA.length?'A':'B');
  for(let i=newLabels.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[newLabels[i],newLabels[j]]=[newLabels[j],newLabels[i]];}
  // animate by gradually changing labels one at a time
  for(let k=0;k<all.length;k++){
    all[k].label=newLabels[k];
    drawPermData(true);
    await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,28));
  }
  // compute diff for this shuffle
  const aVals=all.filter(d=>d.label==='A').map(d=>d.v);
  const bVals=all.filter(d=>d.label==='B').map(d=>d.v);
  const diff=mean(bVals)-mean(aVals);
  permNull.push(diff);
  // update null
  const extreme=permNull.filter(v=>Math.abs(v)>=Math.abs(permObs)).length;
  set('perm-count',permNull.length.toLocaleString());
  set('perm-p',(extreme/permNull.length).toFixed(4));
  set('perm-nullm',mean(permNull).toFixed(3));
  set('perm-nulls',sdv(permNull).toFixed(3));
  drawPermNull(diff);
  updatePermExplanation();
  // restore original labels
  await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600));
  all.forEach(d=>d.label=d.origLabel);
  drawPermData();
  permAnimating=false;
}
function runPermutations(){
  if(!permA.length)generatePermData();
  const batch=+document.getElementById('perm-batch').value;
  for(let i=0;i<batch;i++)permNull.push(onePerm());
  const extreme=permNull.filter(v=>Math.abs(v)>=Math.abs(permObs)).length;
  const p=extreme/permNull.length;
  set('perm-count',permNull.length.toLocaleString());set('perm-p',p.toFixed(4));set('perm-nullm',mean(permNull).toFixed(3));set('perm-nulls',sdv(permNull).toFixed(3));
  drawPermNull();
  updatePermExplanation();
}
function drawPermData(animMode){
  const r=clr('permDataC',260),ctx=r.ctx,W=r.W,H=r.H,pad=30;
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  // gradient bg
  const grd=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,W,0);
  grd.addColorStop(0,'rgba(37,99,235,0.07)');grd.addColorStop(0.5,'rgba(100,100,100,0.04)');grd.addColorStop(1,'rgba(220,38,38,0.07)');
  ctx.fillStyle=grd;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.12)';ctx.strokeRect(pad,pad,W-2*pad,H-2*pad);
  if(!permA.length)return;
  const all=permA.concat(permB);
  const ys=all.map(d=>d.v),ymin=Math.min(...ys),ymax=Math.max(...ys),yr=(ymax-ymin)||1;
  const yp=v=>H-pad-((v-ymin)/yr)*(H-2*pad);
  // horizontal line down the middle separating A (left) from B (right) visually
  const midX=W/2;
  ctx.setLineDash([4,4]);ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(midX,pad);ctx.lineTo(midX,H-pad);ctx.stroke();ctx.setLineDash([]);
  // draw points at original X position but colored by current label
  all.forEach((d,i)=>{
    const isA_orig=i<permA.length;
    const xPos=isA_orig
      ? pad+((i+1)/(permA.length+1))*((W-2*pad)/2-10)
      : W/2+10+((i-permA.length+1)/(permB.length+1))*((W-2*pad)/2-10);
    const y=yp(d.v);
    const col=d.label==='A'?'rgba(37,99,235,':'rgba(220,38,38,';
    // glow when label differs from orig position (shuffled)
    const shuffled=d.label!==d.origLabel;
    if(shuffled&&animMode){
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(xPos,y,8,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=col+'0.18)';ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(xPos,y,4.5,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=col+'0.9)';ctx.fill();
    if(shuffled&&animMode){ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,200,0,0.9)';ctx.lineWidth=1.5;ctx.stroke();}
  });
  // means indicators
  const aMean=mean(all.filter(d=>d.label==='A').map(d=>d.v));
  const bMean=mean(all.filter(d=>d.label==='B').map(d=>d.v));
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(37,99,235,0.7)';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pad,yp(aMean));ctx.lineTo(W/2-5,yp(aMean));ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(220,38,38,0.7)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(W/2+5,yp(bMean));ctx.lineTo(W-pad,yp(bMean));ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(100,100,100,0.85)';ctx.font='11px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('Group A (left)',W/4,H-8);
  ctx.fillText('Group B (right)',3*W/4,H-8);
  // diff annotation
  ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillStyle='rgba(50,50,50,0.85)';ctx.font='bold 11px sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(`diff = ${(bMean-aMean).toFixed(3)}`,W/2,pad+14);
}
function drawPermNull(highlightVal){
  const r=clr('permNullC',260),ctx=r.ctx,W=r.W,H=r.H,pad=30;
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  const grd=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,pad,0,H-pad);
  grd.addColorStop(0,'rgba(124,58,237,0.04)');grd.addColorStop(1,'rgba(124,58,237,0.12)');
  ctx.fillStyle=grd;ctx.fillRect(pad,pad,W-2*pad,H-2*pad);
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.12)';ctx.strokeRect(pad,pad,W-2*pad,H-2*pad);
  if(!permNull.length){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(120,120,120,0.6)';ctx.font='13px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('Run or animate a permutation to build this up',W/2,H/2);return;}
  const vals=permNull.slice();
  const mn=Math.min(...vals,permObs,-Math.abs(permObs)),mx=Math.max(...vals,permObs,Math.abs(permObs));
  const bins=32,bw=(mx-mn)/bins||0.001;
  const counts=new Array(bins).fill(0);
  vals.forEach(v=>{counts[Math.min(bins-1,Math.floor((v-mn)/bw))]++;});
  const maxC=Math.max(...counts)||1,iW=W-2*pad,iH=H-2*pad;
  // shade extreme bins (|v| >= |obs|) a different color
  counts.forEach((c,i)=>{
    const bh=(c/maxC)*(iH-20);
    const binCenter=mn+(i+0.5)*bw;
    const isExtreme=Math.abs(binCenter)>=Math.abs(permObs);
    ctx.fillStyle=isExtreme?'rgba(220,38,38,0.65)':'rgba(124,58,237,0.6)';
    ctx.fillRect(pad+i*iW/bins+0.5,H-pad-bh,iW/bins-1,bh);
  });
  // observed diff vertical line
  const xObs=pad+((permObs-mn)/(mx-mn||1))*iW;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(xObs,pad);ctx.lineTo(xObs,H-pad);ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(220,38,38,0.95)';ctx.lineWidth=2.5;ctx.stroke();
  // mirror line (−obs)
  const xMirror=pad+((-permObs-mn)/(mx-mn||1))*iW;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.setLineDash([3,3]);ctx.moveTo(xMirror,pad);ctx.lineTo(xMirror,H-pad);ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(220,38,38,0.5)';ctx.lineWidth=1.5;ctx.stroke();ctx.setLineDash([]);
  // label observed
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(220,38,38,0.9)';ctx.font='bold 11px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='left';
  ctx.fillText('observed',Math.min(W-70,xObs+6),pad+14);
  // highlight just-added value with a quick flash
  if(highlightVal!==undefined){
    const xh=pad+((highlightVal-mn)/(mx-mn||1))*iW;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(xh,H-pad-8,6,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,200,0,0.9)';ctx.fill();
  }
  // axis label
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(100,100,100,0.75)';ctx.font='11px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('shuffled mean differences',W/2,H-8);
  // tail shaded annotation
  ctx.textAlign='right';ctx.fillStyle='rgba(100,100,100,0.65)';
  ctx.fillText(`red bars = as extreme as observed (${permNull.filter(v=>Math.abs(v)>=Math.abs(permObs)).length}/${permNull.length})`,W-pad-2,pad+14);
}
btn('perm-gen',generatePermData);
btn('perm-animate',animatePerm);
btn('perm-run',runPermutations);
btn('perm-reset',()=>{permA=[];permB=[];permNull=[];permObs=0;set('perm-obs','—');set('perm-count',0);set('perm-p','—');set('perm-nullm','—');set('perm-nulls','—');drawPermData();drawPermNull();updatePermExplanation();});

/* ========= SIMPSON'S PARADOX ========= */
let simpData=[],simpView=0; // 0 = both, 1 = aggregate only, 2 = subgroups only
sl('simp-n','simp-n-v');sl('simp-slope','simp-slope-v',v=>v.toFixed(1));sl('simp-off','simp-off-v',v=>v.toFixed(1));sl('simp-noise','simp-noise-v',v=>v.toFixed(1));
function fitLine(data){const xs=data.map(d=>d.x),ys=data.map(d=>d.y),mx=mean(xs),my=mean(ys);let sxx=0,sxy=0,syy=0;for(let i=0;i<data.length;i++){const dx=xs[i]-mx,dy=ys[i]-my;sxx+=dx*dx;sxy+=dx*dy;syy+=dy*dy;}const b1=sxy/(sxx||1e-9),b0=my-b1*mx,r=sxy/Math.sqrt((sxx||1e-9)*(syy||1e-9));return{b0,b1,r};}
function generateSimpson(){
  const n=val('simp-n'),slope=val('simp-slope'),off=val('simp-off'),noise=val('simp-noise');
  simpData=[];
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const xA=Math.random()*4;const yA=off+slope*xA+randn()*noise;simpData.push({x:xA,y:yA,g:'A'});}
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const xB=6+Math.random()*4;const yB=-off+slope*xB+randn()*noise;simpData.push({x:xB,y:yB,g:'B'});}
  drawSimpson();
}
function drawSimpson(){
  const r=clr('simpC',440),ctx=r.ctx,W=r.W,H=r.H,pad=34,iW=W-2*pad,iH=H-2*pad;
  // subtle gradient bg
  const grd=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  grd.addColorStop(0,'rgba(16,185,129,0.04)');grd.addColorStop(1,'rgba(37,99,235,0.04)');
  ctx.fillStyle=grd;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  if(!simpData.length){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(120,120,120,0.6)';ctx.font='14px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('Click "Generate paradox"',W/2,H/2);return;}
  const xs=simpData.map(d=>d.x),ys=simpData.map(d=>d.y);
  const xmin=Math.min(...xs),xmax=Math.max(...xs),ymin=Math.min(...ys),ymax=Math.max(...ys);
  const xpad=(xmax-xmin)*0.1+0.2,ypad=(ymax-ymin)*0.1+0.2;
  const x0=xmin-xpad,x1=xmax+xpad,y0=ymin-ypad,y1=ymax+ypad;
  const xp=x=>pad+(x-x0)/(x1-x0)*iW,yp=y=>H-pad-(y-y0)/(y1-y0)*iH;
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.12)';ctx.strokeRect(pad,pad,iW,iH);
  // gridlines
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.05)';ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let i=1;i<6;i++){const y=pad+i/6*iH;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pad,y);ctx.lineTo(W-pad,y);ctx.stroke();const x=pad+i/6*iW;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,pad);ctx.lineTo(x,H-pad);ctx.stroke();}
  // compute centroids per group (needed for shaded regions and the cross-group line)
  const dataA=simpData.filter(d=>d.g==='A'),dataB=simpData.filter(d=>d.g==='B');
  const cenA={x:mean(dataA.map(d=>d.x)),y:mean(dataA.map(d=>d.y))};
  const cenB={x:mean(dataB.map(d=>d.x)),y:mean(dataB.map(d=>d.y))};
  // shaded convex-ish ellipses around each group cloud — helps viewer see "the groups live in different regions"
  function drawCloud(data,color){
    if(!data.length)return;
    const mx=mean(data.map(d=>d.x)),my=mean(data.map(d=>d.y));
    const sx=Math.max(sdv(data.map(d=>d.x)),0.3),sy=Math.max(sdv(data.map(d=>d.y)),0.3);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(xp(mx),yp(my));
    // scale to data space
    const rx=(sx*2.4)/(x1-x0)*iW/2,ry=(sy*2.4)/(y1-y0)*iH/2;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(0,0,rx,ry,0,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
  }
  if(simpView===0||simpView===2){
    drawCloud(dataA,'rgba(37,99,235,0.07)');
    drawCloud(dataB,'rgba(220,38,38,0.07)');
  }
  // draw points
  simpData.forEach(d=>{
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(xp(d.x),yp(d.y),5,0,Math.PI*2);
    if(simpView===1){
      ctx.fillStyle='rgba(100,100,100,0.55)';
    }else{
      ctx.fillStyle=d.g==='A'?'rgba(37,99,235,0.82)':'rgba(220,38,38,0.82)';
    }
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.stroke();
  });
  const allFit=fitLine(simpData),aFit=fitLine(dataA),bFit=fitLine(dataB);
  function drawArrowLine(fit,color,width){
    const y0f=fit.b0+fit.b1*x0,y1f=fit.b0+fit.b1*x1;
    const x0pp=xp(x0),y0pp=yp(y0f),x1pp=xp(x1),y1pp=yp(y1f);
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x0pp,y0pp);ctx.lineTo(x1pp,y1pp);ctx.strokeStyle=color;ctx.lineWidth=width;ctx.stroke();
    const ang=Math.atan2(y1pp-y0pp,x1pp-x0pp);const ah=10;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x1pp,y1pp);ctx.lineTo(x1pp-ah*Math.cos(ang-Math.PI/7),y1pp-ah*Math.sin(ang-Math.PI/7));ctx.lineTo(x1pp-ah*Math.cos(ang+Math.PI/7),y1pp-ah*Math.sin(ang+Math.PI/7));ctx.closePath();ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.fill();
  }
  if(simpView===0||simpView===1){drawArrowLine(allFit,'rgba(16,185,129,0.95)',3.2);}
  if(simpView===0||simpView===2){drawArrowLine(aFit,'rgba(37,99,235,0.95)',2.6);drawArrowLine(bFit,'rgba(220,38,38,0.95)',2.6);}
  // KEY EXPLANATORY LAYER: draw centroids + dashed line between them
  // this is the "cross-group trend" — it shows WHY the aggregate line points the way it does
  if(simpView===0||simpView===1){
    // dashed gold line from centroid of A to centroid of B
    ctx.setLineDash([6,5]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(xp(cenA.x),yp(cenA.y));
    ctx.lineTo(xp(cenB.x),yp(cenB.y));
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(245,158,11,0.9)';ctx.lineWidth=2.5;ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    // centroid markers
    [[cenA,'rgba(37,99,235,1)','A'],[cenB,'rgba(220,38,38,1)','B']].forEach(([c,col,lbl])=>{
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(xp(c.x),yp(c.y),9,0,Math.PI*2);
      ctx.fillStyle='white';ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle=col;ctx.lineWidth=3;ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle=col;ctx.font='bold 10px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
      ctx.fillText(lbl,xp(c.x),yp(c.y));
    });
    // label midpoint of the cross-group line
    const midX=(xp(cenA.x)+xp(cenB.x))/2,midY=(yp(cenA.y)+yp(cenB.y))/2;
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(245,158,11,1)';ctx.font='bold 10px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='bottom';
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(midX,midY-8);
    ctx.fillText('cross-group trend',0,0);
    ctx.restore();
  }
  // annotations in top-left
  ctx.font='bold 12px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='left';ctx.textBaseline='alphabetic';
  if(simpView!==2){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(16,185,129,0.95)';
    ctx.fillText('overall: '+(allFit.b1>0?'↑':'↓')+' slope = '+allFit.b1.toFixed(2),pad+8,pad+18);
  }
  if(simpView!==1){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(37,99,235,0.95)';ctx.fillText('group A: '+(aFit.b1>0?'↑':'↓')+' slope = '+aFit.b1.toFixed(2),pad+8,pad+36);
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(220,38,38,0.95)';ctx.fillText('group B: '+(bFit.b1>0?'↑':'↓')+' slope = '+bFit.b1.toFixed(2),pad+8,pad+52);
  }
  // paradox badge
  const paradox=(Math.sign(allFit.b1)!==Math.sign(aFit.b1)&&Math.sign(aFit.b1)===Math.sign(bFit.b1));
  if(paradox&&simpView===0){
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(245,158,11,0.95)';ctx.fillRect(W-pad-130,pad+8,120,26);
    ctx.fillStyle='white';ctx.font='bold 12px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText('⚠ paradox detected',W-pad-70,pad+25);
  }
  set('simp-all',allFit.b1.toFixed(3));set('simp-a',aFit.b1.toFixed(3));set('simp-b',bFit.b1.toFixed(3));set('simp-r',allFit.r.toFixed(3));
  set('simp-pattern',paradox?'Paradox visible':'Same direction');
  // update the live explanation text
  updateSimpsonExplanation(allFit,aFit,bFit,cenA,cenB,paradox);
}
function updateSimpsonExplanation(allFit,aFit,bFit,cenA,cenB,paradox){
  const el=document.getElementById('simp-explain-text');
  if(!el)return;
  const ag=allFit.b1,a=aFit.b1,b=bFit.b1;
  const dirAll=ag>0?'upward':'downward';
  const dirSub=(a+b)/2>0?'upward':'downward';
  const cenDx=cenB.x-cenA.x,cenDy=cenB.y-cenA.y;
  const cenSlope=cenDx!==0?cenDy/cenDx:0;
  const cenDir=cenSlope>0?'upward':'downward';
  let txt='';
  if(paradox){
    txt=`<strong style="color:#d97706;">Paradox is active.</strong> Look at three different slopes living on the same plot and notice they disagree:`;
    txt+=`<div style="margin:8px 0 8px 18px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.9;">
      • <strong style="color:#2563eb;">Group A slope: ${a.toFixed(2)}</strong> — inside the blue cloud, y rises ${a>0?'with':'against'} x<br>
      • <strong style="color:#dc2626;">Group B slope: ${b.toFixed(2)}</strong> — inside the red cloud, y also ${b>0?'rises':'falls'} with x<br>
      • <strong style="color:#059669;">Overall slope: ${ag.toFixed(2)}</strong> — fitting one line through all ${simpData.length} points, y <em>${ag>0?'rises':'falls'}</em> with x — <strong>the opposite direction!</strong>
    </div>`;
    txt+=`<strong>The mechanical explanation.</strong> Group A's center of mass sits at (x̄ = ${cenA.x.toFixed(2)}, ȳ = ${cenA.y.toFixed(2)}). Group B's sits at (x̄ = ${cenB.x.toFixed(2)}, ȳ = ${cenB.y.toFixed(2)}). The gold dashed line connecting those two centers has slope <strong>${cenSlope.toFixed(2)}</strong> — pointing <strong>${cenDir}</strong>. When you fit an aggregate regression line, it is <em>forced</em> to pass close to both cloud centers, so its slope is dragged toward that ${cenSlope.toFixed(2)} cross-group slope. The within-group pattern is completely overruled by the between-group pattern.`;
    txt+=`<br><br><strong>The statistical insight.</strong> Any single fitted slope is a <em>weighted average</em> of two things: the within-group relationship (what happens as x changes <em>inside</em> each group) and the between-group relationship (what happens as you <em>switch</em> from one group to another). When these two point different directions, you get Simpson's paradox. The aggregate line simply reports the stronger signal, which in this case is the cross-group signal.`;
    txt+=`<br><br><strong>Real-world takeaway.</strong> If you ever see a "surprising" correlation in aggregated data, stop and ask: is there a grouping variable I have not controlled for? Examples beyond Berkeley: a hospital with a <em>higher</em> overall death rate than a rival may have <em>lower</em> death rates in every patient risk category (because it treats sicker patients); a baseball player with a <em>higher</em> yearly batting average than a rival may have <em>lower</em> batting averages across every individual season (because season-to-season mix varies); a drug that looks <em>worse</em> on average may be <em>better</em> for every subgroup of patients. Every one of these is Simpson's paradox.`;
    txt+=`<br><br><strong>The fix.</strong> Never report a trend from aggregated data without checking whether it holds inside natural subgroups. If it reverses — and for policy decisions, medical trials, or fairness audits that reversal matters enormously — report the subgroup analysis, or use stratified/adjusted models. "On average" is often the most dangerous phrase in statistics.`;
  }else{
    const sameDir=Math.sign(ag)===Math.sign(a)&&Math.sign(a)===Math.sign(b);
    txt=`No paradox right now — the three slopes broadly agree on direction.`;
    txt+=`<div style="margin:8px 0 8px 18px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.9;">
      • <strong style="color:#2563eb;">Group A slope: ${a.toFixed(2)}</strong><br>
      • <strong style="color:#dc2626;">Group B slope: ${b.toFixed(2)}</strong><br>
      • <strong style="color:#059669;">Overall slope: ${ag.toFixed(2)}</strong> (${dirAll})<br>
      • Cross-group trend (gold line): ${cenSlope.toFixed(2)} (${cenDir})
    </div>`;
    txt+=`Notice that the cross-group slope (${cenSlope.toFixed(2)}) points the <em>same</em> way as the within-group slopes, so there's nothing for the aggregate fit to fight against — everything pulls the same direction.`;
    txt+=`<br><br><strong>To create the paradox:</strong> you need the cross-group slope (gold dashed line) to point <em>opposite</em> to the within-group slopes. The easiest recipe:`;
    txt+=`<div style="margin:8px 0 8px 18px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.9;">
      1. Set "Within-group slope" positive (say, <strong>+0.7</strong> or higher).<br>
      2. Crank "Group offset" up to <strong>4 or 5</strong> — this pushes Group B down on the y-axis while keeping it right-shifted on the x-axis.<br>
      3. The gold dashed line will now tilt <em>down</em> from A's center to B's center, while the blue and red lines still tilt up.<br>
      4. The aggregate fit will follow the gold line and flip direction. ⚠ Paradox.
    </div>`;
    txt+=`You can also flip the sign of the within-group slope (make it negative) and keep everything else positive — the paradox will appear in the opposite direction.`;
  }
  el.innerHTML=txt;
}
btn('simp-gen',generateSimpson);
btn('simp-view',function(){
  simpView=(simpView+1)%3;
  const labels=['both','overall only','subgroups only'];
  this.textContent='View: '+labels[simpView];
  drawSimpson();
});
btn('simp-reveal',()=>{simpView=0;document.getElementById('simp-view').textContent='View: both';drawSimpson();});

/* ========= COMBINATIONS ========= */
sl('cmb-n','cmb-n-v');sl('cmb-r','cmb-r-v');
function factorial(n){if(n<0)return NaN;if(n>170)return Infinity;let f=1;for(let i=2;i<=n;i++)f*=i;return f;}
function choose(n,r){if(r<0||r>n)return 0;if(r===0||r===n)return 1;r=Math.min(r,n-r);let c=1;for(let i=0;i<r;i++){c=c*(n-i)/(i+1);}return Math.round(c);}
function fmtNum(n){if(!isFinite(n))return '∞';if(n>1e15)return n.toExponential(2);return n.toLocaleString();}
function updateCombo(){
  let n=val('cmb-n'),r=val('cmb-r');
  if(r>n){r=n;document.getElementById('cmb-r').value=n;set('cmb-r-v',n);}
  const c=choose(n,r);
  const nf=factorial(n),rf=factorial(r),nrf=factorial(n-r);
  const perm=rf>0?(nf/nrf):0;
  set('cmb-n-eq',n);set('cmb-r-eq',r);
  set('cmb-nfact',n+'!');set('cmb-rfact',r+'!');set('cmb-nrfact',(n-r)+'!');
  set('cmb-result',fmtNum(c));
  set('cmb-m-result',fmtNum(c));
  set('cmb-m-perm',fmtNum(perm));
  set('cmb-m-nfact',fmtNum(nf));
  set('cmb-m-pascal','Row '+n);
  // explanation text
  const ex=document.getElementById('cmb-explain');
  const examples={'team':'team members from a pool','cards':'cards from a deck','committee':'committee members','books':'books from a shelf','pizza toppings':'pizza toppings'};
  const keys=Object.keys(examples);
  const ctx=examples[keys[n%keys.length]];
  ex.innerHTML=`There are <strong>${fmtNum(c)}</strong> different ways to choose <strong>${r}</strong> ${ctx} from <strong>${n}</strong>.`;
  // build chips
  const demo=document.getElementById('cmb-demo');
  demo.innerHTML='';
  const mode=document.getElementById('cmb-mode').value;
  if(mode==='enumerate'&&n<=8&&c<=60){
    // show the actual combinations
    const items=Array.from({length:n},(_,i)=>String.fromCharCode(65+i));
    const combos=[];
    function combHelper(start,curr){
      if(curr.length===r){combos.push([...curr]);return;}
      for(let i=start;i<items.length;i++){curr.push(items[i]);combHelper(i+1,curr);curr.pop();}
    }
    combHelper(0,[]);
    combos.slice(0,30).forEach(co=>{
      const chip=document.createElement('div');chip.className='combo-chip';chip.textContent='{'+co.join(',')+'}';demo.appendChild(chip);
    });
    if(combos.length>30){const more=document.createElement('div');more.className='combo-chip';more.style.opacity='0.6';more.textContent=`+ ${combos.length-30} more`;demo.appendChild(more);}
  }else if(mode==='formula'){
    // show the items being chosen interactively
    for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
      const chip=document.createElement('div');chip.className='combo-chip'+(i<r?' selected':'');chip.textContent=String.fromCharCode(65+i);demo.appendChild(chip);
    }
  }
  drawComboViz();
  updateComboGuide(n,r,c,mode);
}
function updateComboGuide(n,r,c,mode){
  const title=document.getElementById('cmb-guide-title');
  const el=document.getElementById('cmb-guide-text');
  if(!el||!title)return;
  const fm=fmtNum;
  if(mode==='pascal'){
    title.textContent=`Pascal's triangle — how to read it with C(${n}, ${r}) = ${fm(c)}`;
    let txt=`<strong>What it is.</strong> Pascal's triangle is a stack of numbers where every entry is the sum of the two entries directly above it. The outer edges are all 1s, and everything in between is built up by that simple addition rule. It was known to Indian, Persian, Chinese, and Greek mathematicians centuries before Blaise Pascal studied it in 1653, but his name stuck in Europe.`;
    txt+=`<br><br><strong>Why it matters here.</strong> Every number in the triangle is a combination count. The entry in <em>row n, position r</em> (counting from 0) is exactly <strong>C(n, r)</strong> — the number of ways to choose r items from n. So the triangle is a complete lookup table for the combinations formula, built entirely by addition.`;
    txt+=`<br><br><strong>Reading the current highlight.</strong> The gold-filled circle sits at row <strong>${n}</strong>, position <strong>${r}</strong>. That position holds the value <strong>${fm(c)}</strong>, which is C(${n}, ${r}) — the number of distinct ways you can choose ${r} things from ${n}. The faintly-shaded 1s running down both diagonal edges are the boundary cases: C(k, 0) = 1 (only one way to choose nothing) and C(k, k) = 1 (only one way to choose everything).`;
    txt+=`<br><br><strong>Symmetry you can see.</strong> The triangle is mirror-symmetric: C(n, r) always equals C(n, n − r). Picking r items <em>in</em> is logically the same as picking (n − r) items <em>out</em>, so those two counts must match. For your current value, C(${n}, ${r}) = ${fm(c)} = C(${n}, ${n-r}). That's why the gold circle has a twin on the opposite side of the row.`;
    txt+=`<br><br><strong>The additive rule in action.</strong> If you pick any non-edge entry, it equals the sum of the two entries directly above it: C(n, r) = C(n−1, r−1) + C(n−1, r). This isn't just a numerical trick — it reflects a real choice: to form a committee of r people from n candidates, you either <em>include</em> the first candidate (then choose r−1 from the remaining n−1) or <em>exclude</em> them (then choose r from the remaining n−1). The two cases don't overlap and cover everything, so their counts add.`;
    txt+=`<br><br><strong>Row sums.</strong> Each row sums to a power of 2: row n adds up to 2ⁿ. That is the total number of subsets of an n-element set (every element is either in or out — 2 choices, n times). Row ${n} sums to 2<sup>${n}</sup> = ${fm(Math.pow(2,n))}, and the C(${n}, k) values you see are the breakdown of that total by subset size.`;
    el.innerHTML=txt;
  }else if(mode==='enumerate'){
    title.textContent=`Enumerating every combination of ${r} from ${n}`;
    let txt=`<strong>What you are looking at.</strong> Each chip above is one of the <strong>${fm(c)}</strong> distinct ways to pick ${r} item${r===1?'':'s'} from the set {A, B, C, …} of size ${n}. `;
    if(n>8||c>60){
      txt+=`This view is only drawn when n ≤ 8 and the count fits on screen — try smaller values to see every combination spelled out.`;
    }else{
      txt+=`The set braces { } signal that order does not matter: {A, B, C} and {C, A, B} are the same committee and are listed only once.`;
    }
    txt+=`<br><br><strong>Why the count comes out to ${fm(c)}.</strong> If order <em>did</em> matter, you'd have P(${n}, ${r}) = ${fm(factorial(n)/factorial(n-r))} arrangements — each subset of size ${r} can be written in ${r}! = ${fm(factorial(r))} different orders. Dividing those arrangements by ${r}! collapses each subset to one entry and gives you C(${n}, ${r}) = ${fm(c)}.`;
    txt+=`<br><br>The bar chart below shows the count for every possible choice size — notice that C(${n}, ${r}) = ${fm(c)} is just one bar in the full landscape of possibilities.`;
    el.innerHTML=txt;
  }else{
    title.textContent=`How the formula produces C(${n}, ${r}) = ${fm(c)}`;
    let txt=`<strong>Step by step.</strong> The formula C(n, r) = n! / [r! · (n−r)!] counts the ways to pick r items from n when order is irrelevant. For your current values:`;
    txt+=`<div style="margin:8px 0 8px 18px;font-family:var(--mono);line-height:1.9;">
      • <strong>${n}!</strong> = ${fm(factorial(n))} — the number of ways to arrange all ${n} items in order<br>
      • <strong>${r}!</strong> = ${fm(factorial(r))} — redundant orderings <em>inside</em> the chosen group<br>
      • <strong>(${n} − ${r})! = ${n-r}!</strong> = ${fm(factorial(n-r))} — redundant orderings inside the <em>unchosen</em> group<br>
      • <strong>C(${n}, ${r}) = ${fm(factorial(n))} / (${fm(factorial(r))} · ${fm(factorial(n-r))}) = ${fm(c)}</strong>
    </div>`;
    txt+=`<strong>Intuition.</strong> Start with ${n}! = ${fm(factorial(n))} total arrangements of all ${n} items. Every valid "committee of ${r}" is being counted ${fm(factorial(r))} × ${fm(factorial(n-r))} = ${fm(factorial(r)*factorial(n-r))} times (once for each internal reordering of the in-group times each reordering of the out-group). Dividing cancels that double-counting, leaving ${fm(c)} genuinely distinct choices.`;
    txt+=`<br><br><strong>The highlighted bar.</strong> In the chart below, the gold bar sits at k = ${r}. Its neighbors (k = 0, 1, 2, …, ${n}) show how the count rises and then falls as you pick more items. The peak sits in the middle — choosing half gives the most combinations — which is why C(n, n/2) grows so large compared to C(n, 0) or C(n, n).`;
    el.innerHTML=txt;
  }
}
function drawComboViz(){
  const n=val('cmb-n'),r=val('cmb-r'),mode=document.getElementById('cmb-mode').value;
  const info=clr('cmbC',280),ctx=info.ctx,W=info.W,H=info.H;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(217,119,6,0.04)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  if(mode==='pascal'){
    // Pascal's triangle highlighting C(n,r)
    const rows=Math.min(n,15);
    const cellSize=Math.min(W/(rows+2),H/(rows+3));
    const startY=20;
    for(let i=0;i<=rows;i++){
      for(let j=0;j<=i;j++){
        const x=W/2+(j-i/2)*cellSize;
        const y=startY+i*cellSize*0.9;
        const v=choose(i,j);
        const isTarget=(i===n&&j===r);
        const onPath=(i<=n&&(j===0||j===i));
        ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,cellSize*0.35,0,Math.PI*2);
        ctx.fillStyle=isTarget?'rgba(217,119,6,0.95)':(onPath?'rgba(217,119,6,0.2)':'rgba(124,58,237,0.15)');
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle=isTarget?'rgba(217,119,6,1)':'rgba(124,58,237,0.4)';
        ctx.lineWidth=isTarget?2:0.5;ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle=isTarget?'white':'rgba(50,50,50,0.9)';
        ctx.font=`${isTarget?'bold ':''}${Math.max(8,Math.min(12,cellSize*0.35))}px monospace`;
        ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
        ctx.fillText(fmtNum(v).length>6?'...':fmtNum(v),x,y);
      }
    }
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(100,100,100,0.7)';ctx.font='12px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='alphabetic';
    ctx.fillText(`Pascal's Triangle — C(${n},${r}) is highlighted in gold`,W/2,H-10);
  }else{
    // bar chart of C(n,k) for k=0..n
    const vals=[];for(let k=0;k<=n;k++)vals.push(choose(n,k));
    const maxV=Math.max(...vals);
    const pad=30,iW=W-2*pad,iH=H-55;
    const bw=iW/(n+1);
    vals.forEach((v,k)=>{
      const bh=(v/maxV)*iH;const x=pad+k*bw,y=H-30-bh;
      ctx.fillStyle=k===r?'rgba(217,119,6,0.9)':'rgba(124,58,237,0.45)';
      ctx.fillRect(x+2,y,bw-4,bh);
      if(k===r){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(50,50,50,0.95)';ctx.font='bold 11px monospace';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText(fmtNum(v),x+bw/2,y-4);}
      if(n<=15){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(100,100,100,0.7)';ctx.font='10px monospace';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText(k,x+bw/2,H-14);}
    });
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(100,100,100,0.8)';ctx.font='12px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText(`All combinations C(${n}, k) for k = 0 to ${n}`,W/2,20);
  }
}
document.getElementById('cmb-n').addEventListener('input',updateCombo);
document.getElementById('cmb-r').addEventListener('input',updateCombo);
document.getElementById('cmb-mode').addEventListener('change',updateCombo);

/* ========= DECISION TREE ========= */
// Synthesize a Titanic-like dataset (891 passengers with realistic survival patterns)
function makeTitanicData(){
  const d=[];
  // based on the real titanic survival patterns from the course notes:
  // - 62% died overall, 38% survived
  // - females: 74% survived; males: 19% survived
  // - by class: 1st class higher survival, 3rd class lower
  // - children under ~6.5 had higher survival
  for(let i=0;i<891;i++){
    const sex=Math.random()<0.647?'male':'female';
    const pclass=Math.random()<0.24?1:(Math.random()<0.45?2:3);
    const age=Math.random()<0.08?(1+Math.random()*6):(10+Math.random()*60);
    // probability of survival given features (rough fit to the course data)
    let p;
    if(sex==='female'){
      p=pclass===1?0.97:(pclass===2?0.92:0.50);
    }else{
      if(age<6.5){p=pclass===3?0.45:0.85;}
      else{p=pclass===1?0.37:(pclass===2?0.16:0.14);}
    }
    d.push({sex,pclass,age,survived:Math.random()<p?1:0});
  }
  return d;
}
const titanicData=makeTitanicData();

function giniImpurity(rows){if(!rows.length)return 0;const n=rows.length;const s=rows.filter(r=>r.survived===1).length/n;return 1-s*s-(1-s)*(1-s);}
function bestSplit(rows,features){
  let best=null,bestGain=0;
  const parentG=giniImpurity(rows);
  features.forEach(f=>{
    let candidates;
    if(f==='sex')candidates=['male'];
    else if(f==='pclass')candidates=[2,3];
    else if(f==='age')candidates=[6.5,16,32];
    candidates.forEach(thr=>{
      const left=rows.filter(r=>f==='sex'?r[f]===thr:r[f]<thr);
      const right=rows.filter(r=>f==='sex'?r[f]!==thr:r[f]>=thr);
      if(!left.length||!right.length)return;
      const w=(left.length*giniImpurity(left)+right.length*giniImpurity(right))/rows.length;
      const gain=parentG-w;
      if(gain>bestGain){bestGain=gain;best={feature:f,threshold:thr,left,right,gain};}
    });
  });
  return best;
}
function buildTreeRec(rows,depth,maxDepth,minLeaf,features){
  const n=rows.length;
  const survived=rows.filter(r=>r.survived===1).length;
  const prob=n?survived/n:0;
  const node={n,prob,predict:prob>=0.5?1:0};
  if(depth>=maxDepth||n<minLeaf||prob===0||prob===1)return node;
  const split=bestSplit(rows,features);
  if(!split||split.gain<0.001)return node;
  node.split=split;
  node.left=buildTreeRec(split.left,depth+1,maxDepth,minLeaf,features);
  node.right=buildTreeRec(split.right,depth+1,maxDepth,minLeaf,features);
  return node;
}
function treeDepth(t){if(!t.split)return 0;return 1+Math.max(treeDepth(t.left),treeDepth(t.right));}
function countLeaves(t){if(!t.split)return 1;return countLeaves(t.left)+countLeaves(t.right);}
function predictTree(t,row){if(!t.split)return t.predict;const f=t.split.feature,thr=t.split.threshold;const goLeft=f==='sex'?row[f]===thr:row[f]<thr;return goLeft?predictTree(t.left,row):predictTree(t.right,row);}

let currentTree=null;
sl('tree-d','tree-d-v');sl('tree-m','tree-m-v');
function buildTree(){
  const d=val('tree-d'),m=val('tree-m');
  const featMode=document.getElementById('tree-feat').value;
  let features;
  if(featMode==='sex')features=['sex'];
  else if(featMode==='sex_class')features=['sex','pclass'];
  else features=['sex','pclass','age'];
  currentTree=buildTreeRec(titanicData,0,d,m,features);
  // accuracy
  let correct=0;titanicData.forEach(r=>{if(predictTree(currentTree,r)===r.survived)correct++;});
  const acc=correct/titanicData.length;
  set('tree-depth',treeDepth(currentTree));
  set('tree-leaves',countLeaves(currentTree));
  set('tree-acc',(acc*100).toFixed(1)+'%');
  // determine the root feature (always the "most important" because it's the first split)
  set('tree-feat-out',currentTree.split?currentTree.split.feature:'(none)');
  drawTree();
}
function drawTree(){
  const r=clr('treeC',460),ctx=r.ctx,W=r.W,H=r.H;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(220,38,38,0.04)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  if(!currentTree)return;
  // assign x coordinates (in-order layout) and y by depth
  const leaves=[];
  function collectLeaves(t){if(!t.split){leaves.push(t);return;}collectLeaves(t.left);collectLeaves(t.right);}
  collectLeaves(currentTree);
  // assign leaf x positions evenly
  const leafW=(W-60)/Math.max(leaves.length,1);
  leaves.forEach((l,i)=>{l.x=30+leafW*(i+0.5);});
  // compute internal node x as midpoint of children
  function layout(t,depth){
    if(!t.split){t.depth=depth;return t.x;}
    const xl=layout(t.left,depth+1),xr=layout(t.right,depth+1);
    t.depth=depth;t.x=(xl+xr)/2;return t.x;
  }
  layout(currentTree,0);
  const td=treeDepth(currentTree)||1;
  const levelH=(H-60)/(td+1);
  function setY(t){t.y=30+t.depth*levelH;if(t.split){setY(t.left);setY(t.right);}}
  setY(currentTree);
  // draw edges first
  function drawEdges(t){if(!t.split)return;
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.25)';ctx.lineWidth=1.2;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(t.x,t.y+12);ctx.lineTo(t.left.x,t.left.y-12);ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(t.x,t.y+12);ctx.lineTo(t.right.x,t.right.y-12);ctx.stroke();
    // yes/no labels
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(50,50,50,0.65)';ctx.font='9px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';
    ctx.fillText('yes',(t.x+t.left.x)/2-8,(t.y+t.left.y)/2);
    ctx.fillText('no',(t.x+t.right.x)/2+8,(t.y+t.right.y)/2);
    drawEdges(t.left);drawEdges(t.right);
  }
  drawEdges(currentTree);
  // draw nodes
  function drawNode(t){
    const pred=t.predict,conf=pred===1?t.prob:1-t.prob;
    // color by predicted class, saturation by confidence
    const baseH=pred===1?210:145;const sat=30+conf*50,light=80-conf*15;
    const col=`hsl(${baseH},${sat}%,${light}%)`;
    const rad=Math.max(18,Math.min(28,Math.sqrt(t.n)*1.0));
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(t.x,t.y,rad,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=col;ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.stroke();
    // text: prediction probability
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(20,20,20,0.85)';ctx.font=`bold ${Math.min(11,rad*0.48)}px monospace`;ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
    ctx.fillText(pred,t.x,t.y-2);
    ctx.font=`${Math.min(9,rad*0.38)}px monospace`;
    ctx.fillText((t.n+'').length>4?(t.n/1000).toFixed(1)+'k':t.n,t.x,t.y+rad*0.45);
    // split label
    if(t.split){
      ctx.fillStyle='rgba(30,30,30,0.9)';ctx.font='bold 10px monospace';ctx.textAlign='center';
      const lbl=t.split.feature==='sex'?`sex = ${t.split.threshold}`:`${t.split.feature} < ${t.split.threshold}`;
      ctx.fillText(lbl,t.x,t.y-rad-4);
      drawNode(t.left);drawNode(t.right);
    }
  }
  drawNode(currentTree);
  // title
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(50,50,50,0.75)';ctx.font='11px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='left';ctx.textBaseline='alphabetic';
  ctx.fillText('Titanic survival tree — each node shows majority class & passenger count',20,20);
}
btn('tree-build',buildTree);
btn('tree-trace',()=>{
  // highlight a random passenger's path
  if(!currentTree)buildTree();
  const p=titanicData[Math.floor(Math.random()*titanicData.length)];
  // redraw tree fresh, then overlay the passenger's path on top
  drawTree();
  const c=document.getElementById('treeC'),ctx=c.getContext('2d');
  // walk
  let t=currentTree;const path=[t];
  while(t.split){const f=t.split.feature,thr=t.split.threshold;const goLeft=f==='sex'?p[f]===thr:p[f]<thr;t=goLeft?t.left:t.right;path.push(t);}
  // draw path highlight
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(245,158,11,0.9)';ctx.lineWidth=3;
  for(let i=0;i<path.length-1;i++){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(path[i].x,path[i].y);ctx.lineTo(path[i+1].x,path[i+1].y);ctx.stroke();}
  // annotate passenger
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(245,158,11,0.95)';ctx.fillRect(c.offsetWidth-230,30,210,64);
  ctx.fillStyle='white';ctx.font='bold 11px monospace';ctx.textAlign='left';ctx.textBaseline='alphabetic';
  ctx.fillText(`Passenger: ${p.sex}, class ${p.pclass}, age ${p.age.toFixed(0)}`,c.offsetWidth-222,48);
  ctx.fillText(`Actual: ${p.survived===1?'Survived':'Died'}`,c.offsetWidth-222,64);
  ctx.fillText(`Predicted: ${t.predict===1?'Survived':'Died'}`,c.offsetWidth-222,80);
});
document.getElementById('tree-d').addEventListener('input',buildTree);
document.getElementById('tree-m').addEventListener('input',buildTree);
document.getElementById('tree-feat').addEventListener('change',buildTree);

/* ========= RANDOM FOREST ========= */
sl('rf-n','rf-n-v');sl('rf-d','rf-d-v');
let forest=[];
function bootstrap(rows){const out=[];for(let i=0;i<rows.length;i++)out.push(rows[Math.floor(Math.random()*rows.length)]);return out;}
function randomSubset(arr,k){const a=arr.slice();for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]];}return a.slice(0,k);}
function bestSplitRF(rows,features,mtry){const chosen=randomSubset(features,Math.min(mtry,features.length));return bestSplit(rows,chosen);}
function buildTreeRF(rows,depth,maxDepth,features,mtry){
  const n=rows.length;
  const survived=rows.filter(r=>r.survived===1).length;
  const prob=n?survived/n:0;
  const node={n,prob,predict:prob>=0.5?1:0};
  if(depth>=maxDepth||n<5||prob===0||prob===1)return node;
  const split=bestSplitRF(rows,features,mtry);
  if(!split||split.gain<0.001)return node;
  node.split=split;
  node.left=buildTreeRF(split.left,depth+1,maxDepth,features,mtry);
  node.right=buildTreeRF(split.right,depth+1,maxDepth,features,mtry);
  return node;
}
function buildForest(addOnly){
  const n=val('rf-n'),d=val('rf-d'),mtry=+document.getElementById('rf-mtry').value;
  const features=['sex','pclass','age'];
  if(!addOnly)forest=[];
  const target=addOnly?forest.length+10:n;
  while(forest.length<target){
    const boot=bootstrap(titanicData);
    forest.push(buildTreeRF(boot,0,d,features,mtry));
  }
  // predict using forest (majority vote) and tabulate per-passenger vote disagreement to measure diversity
  let correctForest=0,correctSingle=0;
  let disagreementSum=0;
  titanicData.forEach(r=>{
    let votes=0;forest.forEach(t=>{if(predictTree(t,r)===1)votes++;});
    const forestPred=votes>forest.length/2?1:0;
    if(forestPred===r.survived)correctForest++;
    if(predictTree(forest[0],r)===r.survived)correctSingle++;
    // disagreement = how close to a 50/50 split were the votes? Higher = more diversity
    const fracYes=votes/forest.length;
    disagreementSum+=4*fracYes*(1-fracYes);// peaks at 1 when votes are 50/50
  });
  const accForest=correctForest/titanicData.length;
  const accSingle=correctSingle/titanicData.length;
  const avgDisagreement=disagreementSum/titanicData.length;
  set('rf-count',forest.length);
  set('rf-single',(accSingle*100).toFixed(1)+'%');
  set('rf-acc',(accForest*100).toFixed(1)+'%');
  set('rf-imp','+'+((accForest-accSingle)*100).toFixed(1)+'%');
  // feature importance — count how often each feature is used at the root
  const featCount={sex:0,pclass:0,age:0};
  forest.forEach(t=>{if(t.split)featCount[t.split.feature]=(featCount[t.split.feature]||0)+1;});
  const topFeat=Object.entries(featCount).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])[0];
  set('rf-feat',topFeat[0]+' ('+topFeat[1]+'/'+forest.length+' trees)');
  drawForestMain(accForest,accSingle);
  drawMiniTrees();
  updateForestExplanation(accForest,accSingle,avgDisagreement,featCount,mtry,d);
}
function updateForestExplanation(accForest,accSingle,avgDisagreement,featCount,mtry,depth){
  const el=document.getElementById('rf-explain-text');
  if(!el)return;
  if(!forest.length){el.innerHTML='Grow the forest to see how the trees are disagreeing and converging.';return;}
  const imp=(accForest-accSingle)*100;
  const gain=imp>=0?`<strong style="color:#059669;">+${imp.toFixed(1)} percentage points</strong>`:`<strong style="color:#dc2626;">${imp.toFixed(1)} percentage points</strong>`;
  const diversityLabel=avgDisagreement>0.35?'high':(avgDisagreement>0.15?'moderate':'low');
  const diversityColor=avgDisagreement>0.35?'#059669':(avgDisagreement>0.15?'#d97706':'#6b7280');
  // describe the split of root features
  const total=forest.length;
  const rootDesc=Object.entries(featCount).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])
    .map(([f,c])=>`<strong>${f}</strong> (${c}/${total})`).join(', ');
  let txt=`<strong>The committee has ${forest.length} tree${forest.length===1?'':'s'}.</strong> Each one was grown on a different bootstrap resample of the 891 passengers, and at each split was only allowed to consider ${mtry} feature${mtry===1?'':'s'} out of the 3 available. Maximum depth was ${depth} per tree.`;
  txt+=`<br><br><strong>How the trees compare.</strong> A single tree (Tree 1) predicts the training set with <strong>${(accSingle*100).toFixed(1)}%</strong> accuracy. The committee vote reaches <strong>${(accForest*100).toFixed(1)}%</strong> — that's ${gain} from averaging. `;
  if(imp>2){
    txt+='The forest is doing real work: individual trees are making different mistakes, and the vote cancels them out.';
  }else if(imp>=0){
    txt+='The lift is small — that often happens on easy datasets where a single tree already captures most of the signal.';
  }else{
    txt+='Counterintuitively, the forest is doing slightly worse on the training set. This is fine — training-set accuracy is not the right scorecard for a forest; its real strength is <em>generalization</em>, which shows up on held-out data.';
  }
  txt+=`<br><br><strong>Are the trees actually disagreeing?</strong> Average disagreement score: <strong style="color:${diversityColor};">${avgDisagreement.toFixed(2)}</strong> (${diversityLabel}).`;
  txt+=`<br><span style="display:inline-block;background:var(--bg3);border:0.5px solid var(--bdr);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 12px;margin-top:6px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.75;color:var(--txt);">
    <strong>How this number is computed.</strong> For every passenger, we count what fraction <em>p</em> of the ${forest.length} trees voted "Survived". We then compute <strong>4 · p · (1 − p)</strong>, which equals 0 when all trees agree (p = 0 or 1) and peaks at 1 when the vote is perfectly split (p = 0.5). Averaging that quantity across all 891 passengers gives the score shown above. In short: <strong>0 means unanimous, 1 means total chaos</strong>.
  </span> `;
  if(avgDisagreement>0.35){
    txt+='Trees are splitting votes on many passengers — exactly what you want. A diverse forest of disagreeing trees averages out to a smarter final answer.';
  }else if(avgDisagreement>0.15){
    txt+='The trees agree on the easy cases and argue over the hard ones. Typical healthy forest.';
  }else{
    txt+='Trees are voting almost in unison. This usually means bagging + random-feature subsetting is not injecting enough diversity — try reducing "Features tried per split" to 1.';
  }
  txt+=`<br><br><strong>Root-split distribution.</strong> Across all ${forest.length} trees, the feature chosen for the first split was: ${rootDesc}. `;
  if(mtry<3){
    txt+=`Because only ${mtry} feature${mtry===1?' was':'s were'} available at each split, the trees are forced to root-split on different features — which is exactly how Random Forests manufacture diversity.`;
  }else{
    txt+='With all features available at every split, the greedy best choice wins every time and every tree ends up looking similar. That is why mtry &lt; p is usually better.';
  }
  txt+=`<br><br><strong>Try this.</strong> Click "Add 10 more trees" a few times and watch the forest accuracy curve on the plot above. It rises quickly at first, then flattens — diminishing returns. That flattening is the point where the committee has collected enough independent opinions to average out most of the noise.`;
  el.innerHTML=txt;
}
function drawForestMain(accForest,accSingle){
  const r=clr('rfC',320),ctx=r.ctx,W=r.W,H=r.H;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(124,58,237,0.04)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  if(!forest.length){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(120,120,120,0.6)';ctx.font='14px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('Grow the forest to see accuracy over tree count',W/2,H/2);return;}
  // simulate accuracy vs number of trees to make a curve (cumulative voting)
  const pts=[];
  const votes=new Array(titanicData.length).fill(0);
  for(let k=0;k<forest.length;k++){
    titanicData.forEach((r,i)=>{if(predictTree(forest[k],r)===1)votes[i]++;});
    let correct=0;
    titanicData.forEach((r,i)=>{
      const pred=votes[i]>(k+1)/2?1:0;
      if(pred===r.survived)correct++;
    });
    pts.push(correct/titanicData.length);
  }
  const pad=40,iW=W-2*pad,iH=H-2*pad-10;
  const yMin=Math.min(...pts,accSingle)-0.02,yMax=Math.max(...pts,accSingle)+0.02;
  const xp=i=>pad+(i/(Math.max(pts.length-1,1)))*iW;
  const yp=v=>pad+(1-(v-yMin)/(yMax-yMin))*iH;
  // axes
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.12)';ctx.strokeRect(pad,pad,iW,iH);
  // single-tree reference line
  ctx.setLineDash([4,4]);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pad,yp(accSingle));ctx.lineTo(pad+iW,yp(accSingle));ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(150,150,150,0.8)';ctx.lineWidth=1.5;ctx.stroke();ctx.setLineDash([]);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(120,120,120,0.85)';ctx.font='10px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='left';ctx.fillText(`single tree (${(accSingle*100).toFixed(1)}%)`,pad+8,yp(accSingle)-4);
  // forest curve with gradient
  const grd=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,pad,0,H-pad);
  grd.addColorStop(0,'rgba(124,58,237,0.35)');grd.addColorStop(1,'rgba(124,58,237,0.02)');
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pad,H-pad);pts.forEach((v,i)=>ctx.lineTo(xp(i),yp(v)));ctx.lineTo(xp(pts.length-1),H-pad);ctx.closePath();ctx.fillStyle=grd;ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();pts.forEach((v,i)=>{if(i===0)ctx.moveTo(xp(i),yp(v));else ctx.lineTo(xp(i),yp(v));});ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(124,58,237,0.95)';ctx.lineWidth=2.5;ctx.stroke();
  // axis labels
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(100,100,100,0.75)';ctx.font='11px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';
  ctx.fillText('number of trees voting',W/2,H-10);
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(12,H/2);ctx.rotate(-Math.PI/2);ctx.fillText('forest accuracy',0,0);ctx.restore();
  ctx.textAlign='right';ctx.fillStyle='rgba(100,100,100,0.65)';ctx.font='10px monospace';
  ctx.fillText((yMax*100).toFixed(1)+'%',pad-4,pad+5);
  ctx.fillText((yMin*100).toFixed(1)+'%',pad-4,H-pad+3);
  ctx.textAlign='left';ctx.fillText('1',pad,H-pad+14);ctx.textAlign='right';ctx.fillText(forest.length+'',pad+iW,H-pad+14);
}
function drawMiniTrees(){
  const container=document.getElementById('rf-trees');
  container.innerHTML='';
  forest.slice(0,Math.min(forest.length,24)).forEach((tree,idx)=>{
    const box=document.createElement('div');box.className='mini-tree';
    const title=document.createElement('div');title.style.marginBottom='4px';title.style.fontWeight='600';title.style.color='var(--txt2)';title.textContent='Tree '+(idx+1);box.appendChild(title);
    const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=120;canvas.height=80;box.appendChild(canvas);
    // vote bar
    const bar=document.createElement('div');bar.className='vote-bar';
    const yes=document.createElement('div');yes.className='seg';yes.style.background='rgba(37,99,235,0.7)';
    const no=document.createElement('div');no.className='seg';no.style.background='rgba(220,38,38,0.7)';
    // simulate: how often does this tree predict "1"
    let ones=0;titanicData.forEach(r=>{if(predictTree(tree,r)===1)ones++;});
    const frac=ones/titanicData.length;
    yes.style.width=(frac*100)+'%';no.style.width=((1-frac)*100)+'%';
    bar.appendChild(yes);bar.appendChild(no);box.appendChild(bar);
    container.appendChild(box);
    // draw mini tree
    const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
    ctx.fillStyle='#f7f7f6';ctx.fillRect(0,0,120,80);
    // layout tree compactly
    const leaves=[];function cl(t){if(!t.split){leaves.push(t);return;}cl(t.left);cl(t.right);}cl(tree);
    const lw=110/Math.max(leaves.length,1);
    leaves.forEach((l,i)=>{l._x=5+lw*(i+0.5);});
    const td=treeDepth(tree)||1;
    function lay(t,dep){if(!t.split){t._y=10+dep*((60)/(td+1));return t._x;}const xl=lay(t.left,dep+1),xr=lay(t.right,dep+1);t._y=10+dep*((60)/(td+1));t._x=(xl+xr)/2;return t._x;}
    lay(tree,0);
    function de(t){if(!t.split)return;ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';ctx.lineWidth=0.7;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(t._x,t._y);ctx.lineTo(t.left._x,t.left._y);ctx.moveTo(t._x,t._y);ctx.lineTo(t.right._x,t.right._y);ctx.stroke();de(t.left);de(t.right);}
    de(tree);
    function dn(t){ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(t._x,t._y,3,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=t.predict===1?'rgba(37,99,235,0.8)':'rgba(220,38,38,0.8)';ctx.fill();if(t.split){dn(t.left);dn(t.right);}}
    dn(tree);
  });
  if(forest.length>24){const more=document.createElement('div');more.className='mini-tree';more.style.display='flex';more.style.alignItems='center';more.style.justifyContent='center';more.style.color='var(--txt2)';more.textContent='+ '+(forest.length-24)+' more trees';container.appendChild(more);}
}
btn('rf-build',()=>buildForest(false));
btn('rf-add',()=>{if(!forest.length){buildForest(false);}else{buildForest(true);}});
btn('rf-reset',()=>{forest=[];set('rf-count',0);set('rf-single','—');set('rf-acc','—');set('rf-imp','—');set('rf-feat','—');document.getElementById('rf-trees').innerHTML='';const rr=document.getElementById('rf-explain-text');if(rr)rr.innerHTML='Grow the forest to see how the trees are disagreeing and converging.';const r=clr('rfC',320);r.ctx.fillStyle='rgba(124,58,237,0.04)';r.ctx.fillRect(0,0,r.W,r.H);r.ctx.fillStyle='rgba(120,120,120,0.6)';r.ctx.font='14px sans-serif';r.ctx.textAlign='center';r.ctx.fillText('Grow the forest to see accuracy over tree count',r.W/2,r.H/2);});
document.getElementById('rf-n').addEventListener('change',()=>buildForest(false));
document.getElementById('rf-d').addEventListener('change',()=>buildForest(false));
document.getElementById('rf-mtry').addEventListener('change',()=>buildForest(false));

/* ========= INITIAL RENDER ========= */
resetCLT();resetCoin();generateRegression();generatePermData();generateSimpson();updateCombo();
</script>
